create_rl_batcher: create a multi-process RL_Batcher with agent factory, env factory, seeds, and n_processes
reset_rl_batcher: reset all batcher workers with sliced agent_info and env_info DictTensors
execute_rl_batcher: execute batcher workers by acquiring slots and distributing agent_info slices
get_trajectories: get completed Trajectories and still-running count from the batcher buffer
update_rl_batcher: update all batcher process workers with new info DictTensor
